title: Quarterly Remittance Return of Final Income Taxes Withheld

choice_rows.label: Item 13 — Payees availing of tax relief under a Special Law or Tax Treaty?

atc.label: Add an ATC (search by code or nature of payment)

validation.how: Messages go into a Needs review section after the totals (first 20 only); fields only turn their label red, and Queue for submission is disabled while any error exists.

lists.label: Items 13/13A and Part IV — Schedule 1 (tax treaty / special law rates)

findings.now: Choosing No removes every ATC row and all Schedule 1 rows at once, with no warning.
findings.why: set_any_tax_withheld(false) empties the ATC schedule and resets Schedule 1 (form_1601fq.rs:775-785), and the official page asks first (rule 1601fq-change-001, 'You are about to change the value . Doing this will clear all computation fields Do you wish to proceed?'), which the desktop never shows.

options.name: Official confirm
options.detail: Show the official confirmation text and clear only on Yes, leaving the rows in place on No.

options.name: Undo bar
options.detail: Clear as now but keep the removed rows in a one-step Undo bar.

findings.field: Item 13 — Payees availing of tax relief under a Special Law or Tax Treaty?
findings.now: Choosing No deletes every Schedule 1 row (treaty code, ATC, amount and rate) at once, with no prompt.
findings.why: set_tax_relief(None) clears all Schedule 1 rows (form_1601fq.rs:802) and the view reloads blank inputs, although the model's own comment names the official handler confirmDisableTreaty, which suggests a confirmation step.

options.name: Confirm before clearing
options.detail: Ask before clearing and keep the rows if the user declines.

options.name: Hide, do not clear
options.detail: Hide the Schedule 1 rows on No and keep the data until the user chooses Yes again.

findings.now: In March the page accepts Q1 for the current year, but BIR's rule blocks Q1 until April.
findings.why: form_1601fq.rs:1201 blocks only January and February (month0 < 2) and the test at 1796-1815 pins March as open, while rule 1601fq-validate-004 reads 'Current-year Q1 is selected before April.'

options.name: Match the rule
options.detail: Change the Q1 cutoff to block through March, as 1601EQ does, and update the test.

options.name: Check the official HTA
options.detail: Confirm the cutoff in the official source first, then align the rule file and the model together.

findings.now: Print preview draws the September 2020 sheet for a January 2018 return, so the printed layout and item text can differ from the page.
findings.why: The sheet slug is 1601-fq-2020 (form_1601fq_view.rs:1276), and the rules say January 2018 and September 2020 are separate revisions (rules/forms/1601fq-v2018/HANDOFF.md:3).

options.name: Label the preview
options.detail: Show 'This preview uses the September 2020 sheet' in the status message beside the preview.

options.name: Add a 2018 sheet
options.detail: Build and register a January 2018 frozen sheet with its own key map before printing.

findings.now: The Schedule 1 treaty code and ATC are free-text boxes with the placeholders 'NA or US' and 'NA or WI330', so a typo shows up only later under Needs review.
findings.why: The official sheet uses dropdowns (drpTreatyCode and drpATCCode in 1601fq-v2018.json), and the model rejects unknown codes only at validation (form_1601fq.rs:1369 and 1375).

options.name: Dropdown per cell
options.detail: Use a select in each row that starts with NA and then lists the treaty or ATC codes.

options.name: Searchable ATC combobox
options.detail: Use a combobox for the ATC column that filters the 1601-FQ list by code or description.

findings.now: Errors are listed only in a Needs review block after the totals, and only the first 20 appear.
findings.why: The list is cut with take(20) (form_1601fq_view.rs:1312) and drawn last (1429-1430), and fields only turn their label red (459-477).

options.name: Panel under toolbar
options.detail: Pin the Needs review list above the scrolling body so it stays visible while editing.

options.name: Inline messages
options.detail: Show each message under its own field, keyed by the error field names the model returns.

findings.field: Add an ATC (search by code or nature of payment)
findings.now: Up to 12 outline buttons, one per matching ATC, fill the page under Search ATC, and the rest need a narrower search.
findings.why: Forty private or thirty-nine government options each take a full-width button instead of one line of a searchable multi-select.

options.name: Multi-select combobox
options.detail: A combobox that searches code and description and shows each pick as a removable chip.

options.name: Dropdown list
options.detail: A dropdown under the search box that closes after each pick and lists the matches in one scroll area.

findings.now: The year can be retyped on a return opened from a tile, and saving then stores it under that other year.
findings.why: The year is part of the storage key (crates/bir-core/src/db/queueable.rs:144-154), so the tile for the original year no longer finds this draft.

options.name: Read-only year
options.detail: Show the tile's year as text, since the library tile already fixes the period.

options.name: Guarded edit
options.detail: Allow a change only through the tile picker, with a message that it opens a different return.

findings.now: One click queues the return; the official internet and email warning and the question 'Are you sure you want to submit?' never appear.
findings.why: Rule 1601fq-final-001 is not implemented, and mark_submitted queues straight after validation (form_1601fq_view.rs:1151-1206).

options.name: Official confirm
options.detail: Show the full official text with Yes and No, and queue only on Yes.

options.name: Confirm with email
options.detail: Show the email address that will receive the receipt in a confirm step before queueing.

findings.now: The 1601FQ work changed shared files and another form's model, so this form's diff is wider than its own files.
findings.why: 010022d8 touched shared official_xml.rs, queueable.rs, queueable_forms.rs, status.rs and support_level.rs, df8bc455 edited form_1603q.rs (47 changed lines), and 4491832d set render_contract, html_component, html_spec and pagination for 1601FQ, beyond one-line registrations.

options.name: Split commits
options.detail: Move the shared edits and the 1603Q change into their own reviewed commits with the affected sample payloads attached.

options.name: Revert shared edits
options.detail: Restore the shared files from main and keep only form-local 1601FQ code, with the registration line.
